title: Finite refinement makes the positive-degree bottom comparison colimit invertible
statement: Let X be qcqs, A a Grothendieck abelian category, F an A-valued small-etale sheaf and q a positive integer. On the actual filtered homotopy-cohomology diagram [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-hypercover-model], the colimit mediator into the explicitly constructed injective-resolution comparison cocone [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-hypercover-comparison-cocone] is an isomorphism. No arbitrary comparison map is selected: this is colimit.desc of comparisonCocone A F q.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1: hypercover computation, finite staircase through degree q+1; Stacks Tag 01H0 first proof

proof.text: Use the explicit injective-resolution section bicomplex and its canonical comparison cocone. Flip the total-complex convention with the signed totalFlipIso and check both bottom and refinement compatibility. Injective-row acyclicity makes every total comparison invertible.

Prove a finite descending staircase for arbitrary source objects in A. At each leading resolution degree apply detection by local primitives to the exact resolution differential pair. Subtract the total differential of the primitive; the highest component disappears and no higher component is created. An induction combines these detection statements, without choosing a uniform refinement. When only resolution degree zero remains, the evaluated initial resolution kernel lifts it uniquely to F.

Apply the staircase to cycles to show the supremum of canonical comparison images is top. Apply it to a bounding cochain to put every degree≥2 comparison kernel below the supremum of refinement-map kernels. Prove degree-one monicity directly: a degree-zero bounding cochain lifts through the initial kernel and bottom inclusion is monic in degree one.

For the filtered homotopy cohomology diagram, exactness of the colimit functor sends the comparison-kernel natural transformation to zero, since all refinement kernels die in the colimit. The colimit of the constant target is the target by connectedness. Thus the colimit mediator is monic. Its image contains all comparison images, hence is top, so it is epic and therefore invertible.

proof_origin.place: Finite categorical staircase implemented in the Lean proof, following the local correction route of the blueprint and Stacks Tag 01H0. Detection by local primitives is proved from finite refinement and a separately stated categorical local epimorphism lemma, the remaining coefficient-general hole. Degree one uses the evaluated initial kernel; the colimit argument uses AB5 on the actual homotopy cohomology diagram.
